bio: Enjoy the nigiri sushi you like, in the order you like – this is a sushi shop as it’s meant to be, back to basics. In a testament to the chef’s uncompromising standard, the sushi rice is polished just before cooking. A selection of small dishes is available, and sake is also there to be enjoyed. It’s perfectly acceptable to drop in for just a single piece of sushi—a casualness that is much appreciated. Desiring to be admired even overseas, the shop takes the name of Japan’s greatest mountain, to spread the foothills of sushi ever wider....
